title: SAPNI: Added SAP NI as main dissector
description:
Added the SAP NI (Network Interface) dissector protocol from [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/packet-sapni.c).

This is a simple dissector for the NI protocol, mainly responsible for reassembly and calling the right registered dissector based on the port number. Some details and example requests can be found in [pysap's documentation](https://pysap.readthedocs.io/en/latest/protocols/SAPNI.html).

Just rebased the change!

As for the port range, those are correct in the "SAP world". Port numbers in most of the SAP protocols follow a pattern similar to "32NN" or "4NNII" where NN is the instance number and II is the client number. The problem though is that those are proprietary and definitely not IANA assigned.
What you would recommend as the best approach? We can default to the first port number (e.g. 3200 and 40000) and let the user choose the correct range according to the environment they are analyzing. This would definitely limit somehow the dissectors but at lest it shouldn't interfere with other registered port numbers.
Solved the port issue by just keeping 3200 and 40000 in the port range, this can be reviewed later on.
